steps.content: Bureau Recreation Area
Music with strong beats starts to play, which seems to be the intro to some kind of show.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Hey, hey! Shouts to all our audience on both sides of the Rust, Eastside, Syndicate, WhiteSands, Outland, and Paradeisos! And audience in DisSea, if there's any!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wo-hoo! Don't forget MBCC, hehe!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Mua! You're listening to DeadLover Radio's Hallowing special, and I'm here to bring you breaking, urgent, and mega news! This time it's aaaaagain Eastside bringing us the fun!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Woohoo, Syndicate has been left behind for a long time. Ready to surprise everyone again?

steps.speaker: Hella & EMP
steps.content:
Who the **** are you looking down upon?
Hahahaha, I knew they couldn't do anything without me. Hahahaha!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Well, well, I'm getting a good vibe! Let's get started, then! Our topic today is the super exciting themed art exhibition that has lit up Eastside: the <color=#fb9259>Witching Hour</color>!

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Ah, I've heard about it. It's only open for a week every year, and a bunch of live-streams and urban legends around it go viral every time.

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: The horror exhibition features the most bizarre artists and particularly scary "artworks." There are always people who love those for the thrill, so it's quite popular in Eastside.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Oh, but nonono, this year, it's not that. It's...

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Oh, I know that too. This year, it's the first time that all of Witching Hour's exhibitions are from the same artist. Her iconic works go from oil paintings to sculptures. They are super whimsical and the most recent hotshots.

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: But people mostly talk about her. The daughter of a legendary art family, young and beautiful, her parents passed away and she inherited a considerable fortune. It's only been two months since she went viral, but there are already so many rumors about her.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Huh...? First time I've seen you talk so much. Hey, hey, don't steal my lines, 'kay? You're here for the sarcasm, remember?

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Ahem, I was talking about something I learned from my private intelligence network, and it's way more exciting than a beautiful artist...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: This is top-secret news from Eastside: An hour ago, the Witching Hour shut down due to an emergency, and FAC is on the move...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Trust Love's super S-level radar! I'm pretty sure the claimed-to-be-safe Eastside is having yet another secret Mania Crisis! *gasp* Oh no!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: They had visitors missing on the first day of the exhibition. And now... no one is getting out! That is thousands of people that went poof!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: All the damage done to the exterior of the building recovered in seconds, and all communications were cut. The inside is completely isolated, and you can only hear weak crying and screaming... It's a real horror show!!!
DeadLover Radio has been getting good ratings within MBCC. Many Sinners from Syndicate dig the vibe.
Of course, there are some who don't.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Tired. Does she always add so much unnecessary information when talking? The communication efficiency is less than 30%, and as the receiver, it takes up a lot of memory to process.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Hey, that's called humor, hu-mor! DeadLover Radio is very popular. Look, even the brooding bunch, Lisa and Hecate, are here!

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: I heard someone mention some art exhibition and came to check it out. But I see this is a waste of time.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Also, humor is the art of language. You need to at least know how to read to understand it.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wait... Why are you targeting me?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I can't find the Chief. Has he been here?
steps.female_content: I can't find the Chief. Has she been here?

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: No, it's Master's day off, and he left the Bureau at noon. Faye, head of the supply office, gave him a present, and Labyrinth presumed that Master went out for entertainment.
steps.female_content: No, it's Master's day off, and she left the Bureau at noon. Faye, head of the supply office, gave her a present, and Labyrinth presumed that Master went out for entertainment.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Surprised. You claim to care about Master but don't even know his whereabouts? Chuckle.
steps.female_content: Surprised. You claim to care about Master but don't even know her whereabouts? Chuckle.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Fight! Fight! Isn't this Hallowing night? Let's have some fun while that idiot is out!
In this buzz of excitement, the DeadLover Radio show comes to a close.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: That was all the fun Love has to share. If you know something I don't, or if you're planning to visit the event in person, hmm... You know, get in touch!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: A terrifying Mania Crisis is happening in the horror exhibition on the scary Hallowing night. Who doesn't want to see how horrible it can be? I do!
MBCC Command Center
All the department heads have arrived, and the atmosphere here is completely different.

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: Yes, a Mania crisis has been confirmed at the Belphegor Art Museum. Starting at 5:23 p.m., the M-value spiked, and communications were blocked. It was impossible to breach externally, and we lost contact with all personnel who have entered it.

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: FAC has cordoned off the site, but many people have already been involved. Rumors have spread among the public, many civilians are very interested and are trying to force their way into the scene.

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: In addition, during the urgent checking of the missing names, we got unfortunate news that must be confirmed with the Bureau.

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: The name of the MBCC Chief, ${PlayerName}, appears on today's admission list for the Belphegor Art Museum... at 4:57 p.m. No departure recorded.

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: ...Adjutant Nightingale, when was the last time you were in contact with Chief ${PlayerName}?
Nightingale is silent for a long time before looking at Faye with a tight frown, who is standing at the side. Noticing the attention, the Supply Office head raises her hand in surrender.

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: No, no, no! I didn't mean for this to happen. I just figured the Chief has been bored with nothing much to do, and wanted to give him a ticket to a popular exhibition so he could get a break! It's not like I can plan this!
steps.female_content: No, no, no! I didn't mean for this to happen. I just figured the Chief has been bored with nothing much to do, and wanted to give her a ticket to a popular exhibition so she could get a break! It's not like I can plan this!

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: I mean, who would have thought that there's another Mania crisis in Eastside after just a month? I don't want our dear Chief to be trapped in that exhibition either. I'm still waiting for him to give me my year-end bonus...
steps.female_content: I mean, who would have thought that there's another Mania crisis in Eastside after just a month? I don't want our dear Chief to be trapped in that exhibition either. I'm still waiting for her to give me my year-end bonus...

steps.content: The adjutant sighs and waves her hand for the Supply Office head to be quiet.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We can't reach the Chief at the moment, so I'm now acting as the temporary MBCC administrator. Organize a rescue team immediately and head to Eastside. Enter the area of the incident and bring the Chief back.

Eastside
District 10, Belphegor Art Museum
FAC Mutation Lockdown Site

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: What's the situation?

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: The art museum has been cordoned off, the area is on M-value Threat Level C, and there is no sign of high M-value Sinners operating inside. There is currently no presumed risk of Black Ring, but we must take precautions in view of the mutation, since the situation is very abnormal.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Is the affected range too wide?

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: Yes. The entire building is currently isolated by the mutation, affecting an area of 80,000 square meters. Since the opening of the exhibition, the cumulative number of missing persons has reached 5,104, including the FAC advance investigation team that entered a short time ago.

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: The last "person" left the art museum 7 hours ago. He is suffering from mental disorders and has been sent to Banyan Medical College for emergency treatment. Since then, no one has been able to leave.

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: The entire museum is now completely sealed off. We can't breach it from the outside with conventional weapons or send in drones. There are too many curious civilians gathering around, and we have to divide our forces to deal with the situation.

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: If we can reach Chief ${PlayerName}, we might be able to...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We will find him.
The adjutant turns back to the Sinners and begins the deployment.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The museum is huge. In order to find the Chief as soon as possible, you will have to split up. Hella and EMP, take the <color=#fb9259>sculpture section on the east</color>. Hecate and Labyrinth, take the <color=#fb9259>oil painting section on the west</color>.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth & Hecate
steps.content:
Order received.
Understood.

steps.speaker: EMP & Hella
steps.content:
What?! You're signing me up with that lousy rat of Minos?!
What is that supposed to mean?!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Hmm... Nightingale, dear sis, let me switch with Labyrinth! That brooding... Ah, no, Hecate is the most delicate of the 4 of us. She totally needs my protection!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: There's no time. This will maximize your strengths. You're all elites of elites, and I trust you will complete the mission successfully.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: FAC has found possible breakthroughs, and you might be able to enter the Mania mutation area if you use your abilities. Remember, <color=#fb9259>finding the Chief</color> is the first priority. I believe in you.
Nightingale stops paying attention to the Sinners' grunts and turns to look at Lisa. The painter looks at the barricaded art museum somewhat distractedly.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The map you provided was very helpful. Thank you.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: I used to come here for exhibitions. But I didn't expect your people to be so incompetent that they haven't gathered this kind of info already.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This is an urgent situation, and all the staff are trapped inside the museum. We need more reliable sources of information.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Hmph, you didn't tell those numbnuts everything. The situation is actually dire, right?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: You didn't bring those powerful Sinners with higher M-value, fearing this unknown new type of Mania would cause uncontrollable effects on them. And you put the two noisy ones together to attract attention, so the brainy ones can infiltrate more easily.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Hmph, you sure know how to maneuver the talents, Adjutant.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It's just more practical to pair ranged attackers with melee ones. Hella and Hecate often follow the Chief in battle and are experienced. Both sides will be fine with them leading the teams.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: What about you, Lisa? To be honest, I never thought you'd offer to join the action. Which team do you want to be on?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Oh, please. I came for the exhibition, and those blockheads who know nothing about art will only mess it up for me.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: I know a third entrance—<color=#fb9259>the underground staff area</color>. I'll enter from there myself, and I know where to hide in case of danger.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: I don't really know that dull Chief, but it would be upsetting to see good works of art spoiled by some mutation.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Understood. Let's get ready for action, then.
She takes out three navigators with blue dahlia patterns and hands them to the three teams. With shimmering lights, a holographic screen appears.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This is a custom navigator for the Witching Hour exhibition. The area for exploration is limited due to the mutation, but it will provide more information on the way.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Dear friends, welcome to the <color=#fb9259>Belphegor Art Museum</color>, N.F. 112, the 18th annual Witching Hour themed art exhibition.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: I'm <color=#fb9259>Enfer</color>, the only exhibitor this year, and your guide on this art tour. It will be my pleasure to show you around and introduce you to my works.
